text: A niche is reversible and can serve as a vehicle for transferable skill building.
The niche is the overlap between creator interest and audience interest, oriented around the other person's questions, problems, and outcomes.
Specificity improves comprehension and can attract adjacent audiences rather than eliminating them.
A person with a specific problem prefers a specialist who explicitly names it.
Specialization increases pricing power, efficiency, time leverage, capacity, and revenue potential.
Niche switching can be avoidance of the supporting skills required to make the current niche work.
Publish 30 pieces in 30 days, detect two-to-three topics performing about two times better, and double down.
Re-express winning topics for another audience, problem, or outcome and repeat the review cycle.
Lead with one umbrella or tip of the spear, then expand through a content or client constellation.
